title: Worktree Tasks
modelHint: Model used by the task session. Leave empty to use the default.
modelUnavailable: Model selection is unavailable in this environment
acceptanceCriteriaHint: One checkable result per line, e.g. keep the selected item after returning to the list on narrow screens.
acceptanceLibraryHint: Maintain reusable acceptance criteria here; pick them when publishing, or add one-off items manually.
acceptanceLibraryEmpty: No acceptance criteria yet. Add one above.
criteriaPickHint: Pick from the library, or add extra items below.
chooseDirFirst: Choose a directory to load branches
liveCwdOff: Not switched to the worktree yet
pendingHint: The session is waiting for you. Open it to continue.
sessionInterruptedHint: The last run of this session was interrupted. The worktree may still contain unfinished changes.
sessionErrorHint: The last run of this session failed. Open the session to inspect the error.
deleteProjectEmptyHint: This project has no tasks; deleting it cannot be undone.
forceDeleteBranchHint: Only merged branches are deleted by default; unmerged commits require this option.
connectionLost: Connection lost. Retry, or reopen the workbench from the DSH launch URL.
publishTimeout: Publish timed out — refresh the board to confirm whether the task was created
bindTimeout: Task created, but session creation timed out — open or create the session from the board later

notGitRepo: That directory is not a git repository, or it has no commits yet.
projectExists: This repository is already the project "{name}"
projectExistsHint: Adding it again will not create a second project; open the existing one instead.
projectExistsOpened: Already added — opened the existing project "{name}"
noProjectsHint: Choose a Git repository to start publishing worktree tasks.
noMatchHint: Try another keyword, or clear the search to see everything.
addProjectSub: Choose a Git repository, load its branches and set a default base.
overviewHint: Derived from Git and session state
noSessionHint: Create a session to see live turns, todos and context usage here.
acceptanceHintClean: The worktree has been cleaned; review actions are unavailable.
acceptanceHintMerged: Merged into the base branch. You can clean the worktree now.
acceptanceHintBroken: The worktree state is broken. Fix it before reviewing.
acceptanceHintDeveloping: Task is in progress. Finish development before switching to the task branch.
acceptanceHintNotStarted: Task hasn't started yet. Finish development before switching to the task branch.
acceptanceHintDirty: {n} uncommitted changes. Commit or stash before switching or merging.
acceptanceHintRepoDirty: The main repo has {n} uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them before switching branches.
acceptanceHintNoAhead: No commits ahead of the base yet.
acceptanceHintCheckedOut: The main repo is on the task branch. Switch back when done.
acceptanceHintDefault: Switching and merging check the working tree first.
cleanupHint: Cleaning removes the worktree directory. Deleting a record only hides it from the board.
mergeSub: Merge the task branch commits into the base branch.
mergeDirtyHint: Commit or stash them before merging.
cleanupSub: Remove the worktree and its files.
worktreeRemovedHint: The worktree directory was removed. The path is kept for reference.
cleanupForceHint: Clean even when uncommitted changes exist.
cleanupBranchHint: Delete the local branch after cleaning.
deleteTaskWarningHint: The record is removed from the board; the worktree and branch stay on disk.
deleteTaskHint: Merge first if you still need the code.
deleteProjectWarning: The project still has {n} task record(s)
deleteProjectWarningHint: Delete them together to remove the project. The repository and commits stay on disk.
deleteProjectCardHint: Removing a project hides its configuration and task records from the board. The repository and commits stay on disk.
withWorktreesHint: Force-remove the worktree folders on disk; uncommitted changes are lost.
clearRecentsSub: Remove recent repository directories from settings.
clearRecentsHint: Directories and repositories on disk are not deleted.
sessionCreated: Session created and bound to the worktree
branchRule: Leave empty to auto-generate {pattern}. ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore and slash only.
branchInvalid: Use ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen and slash only; it must start with a letter or digit.
projectSettingsHint: Override branch and worktree naming. Applies to future tasks only.
worktreeDirHint: Defaults to ~/.dsh/worktrees as <root>/<project>/. A relative path stays inside the repo and is added to .git/info/exclude.
branchPrefixHint: Auto branches use the prefix plus the 8-character task ID.
mergeSwitchNotice: The main repo is on {branch}; it will switch to base {base} before merging.
switchConflictSub: Uncommitted changes in the main repo would make Git reject the switch.
switchConflictHint: These {n} files block the switch; choose how to handle them:
reviewStashNotice: Uncommitted changes were stashed when switching back ({ref}). Restore them onto the current branch or drop them.
settingsSub: Global configuration and recent repository directories.
configHint: Provided by the host configuration; read-only. Edit it in the DSH config.
recentsHint: Not shown in the add-project dialog. Kept for quick reference and cleanup.
clearRecentsShortHint: Clearing only removes this list; directories on disk stay.
taskNotStartedHint: The task was published, but its first instruction never ran. Start it to continue.
diffEmpty: No changes against the base branch.
diffTruncated: Changes are large — showing a trimmed diff.
diffReasonMissing: the worktree and branch no longer exist
startNowHint: Choosing Yes creates the session and sends the task description right away. Choosing No keeps the task ready to start later.
mergePreviewConflictHint: The base has new commits that conflict with this task. Sync the base in the session first.
mergePreviewOverlapHint: Both sides changed these files. Git may merge them automatically, but review the risk.
mergePreviewNoCheck: This Git version cannot pre-check conflicts; merging runs directly. Watch for conflicts.
mergePrecheckBlocked: Could not complete the conflict pre-check, so merging is blocked. Retry or upgrade Git.
mergeNeedsCleanRepo: The main repo has changes. Commit or discard them before merging; merging requires a clean repo.
mergeBlockedFilesTitle: Changes must be handled before merging
mergeStale: The task branch or base changed. Re-check before merging.
mergeConflictAtExecute: A conflict appeared while merging; the merge was cancelled.
mergeHookFailed: The merge hook failed; the repo was restored.
mergeTimeout: The merge timed out and the repo was cleaned up. Check manually.
mergePartialRestoreFailed: Merged, but could not switch back to the original branch.
repoBusy: The main repo is running another Git operation. Try again shortly.
baseCheckedOutElsewhere: The base branch is checked out by another worktree, so it cannot be switched to.
stashApplyConflict: Restoring the stash hit a conflict; the record is kept.
stashUnverified: Could not match uniquely; verify manually
pendingOpNeedsManual: An unfinished merge operation needs manual handling.
carryNote: {n} newer commits on the previous branch will be carried in by the agent
postMergeHint: This task is merged, but its branch has {n} newer unmerged commits. Merge again as a patch, or start a follow-up task.
acceptanceHintPostMerge: Merged, but the branch has {n} newer commits: merge again as a patch, or continue from this task.
cleanupPredecessorSub: The previous task is merged; its worktree can be cleaned to free space.
cleanupPredecessorHint: Only the worktree directory is removed; the branch and commits stay.
cleanupPredecessorDirty: The previous worktree has {n} uncommitted changes; force clean will discard them.
acceptNotOnBase: Main repo is on {branch}; switch to the base branch first
acceptInProgress: The main repo has an unfinished merge/rebase; resolve it first
acceptAgentRunning: The agent is running; wait for this turn to finish
acceptAgentPending: The session is waiting for your response; handle the pending approval or question first
stashBlocksLifecycle: This task still has pending stashes; restore or drop them first
acceptOtherReviewing: Task "{task}" is being reviewed; switch back first
acceptWorktreeDirtyCommit: The worktree has {n} uncommitted changes; ask the agent to commit first
continueMergedOnlyHint: Ignore commits added to the old branch after the merge; they stay on the old branch.
continueCarryHint: List the {n} post-merge commits in the first prompt and let the agent cherry-pick them in.
publishAsPlain: Publish as a normal task (not linked to the previous task)
baseNotMergeTarget: This base is not the previous task's merge target {base}; publishing will verify it contains the merged results.
syncNoSession: Create a session before syncing the base
syncPrompt:
Please sync the base: merge local {base} into {branch} inside the worktree.
Workbench pre-check: {files}.
Follow the "sync base" rules in your task prompt, then tell me the conflict files and how they were resolved.
archiveHintOff: Archiving hides this task from the left list by default. Use "Show archived" in the sidebar to see it again.
archiveHintOn: This task is archived and hidden from the default list. Unarchiving puts it back.
switchDiscardConfirm: I confirm discarding changes in the above {n} files
reviewStashConflict: Restoring the stash hit conflicts: {files}. The stash was kept; resolve the conflicts, then restore or drop it again.
reviewStashDropConfirm: Drop this stash? It cannot be recovered.
mergeBranchChanged: The task branch or base changed; re-run the pre-check before merging
mergeRestoreFailed: Merged, but could not switch back to the original branch. Switch back manually or retry later.
reviewingBlockHint: This task is under review and the main repo is parked at the review commit (detached HEAD). Deleting the record, cleaning it or deleting the project would leave it with no way back. Return to the original branch first.
reviewDetachedHint: The main repo is parked at review commit {sha} (detached HEAD). Do not commit in the main repo during review; click "Back to original branch" when done.
switchBackFirst: Switch back to the original branch first
reviewStaleTitle: New commits on the task branch during review
reviewStaleHint: The task branch has {n} new commits since review started; you are reviewing an older commit. Switch back and review the latest commit again.
gitTooOldHint: This Git version cannot pre-check merge conflicts (2.38+ required). Merging still works but conflicts are not detected in advance.
mergeNoPrecheckRisk: This Git version cannot pre-check conflicts; merging will run directly. Watch for conflicts.
cleanupBranchUnmerged: This branch has {n} unmerged commit(s); deleting it can only be recovered via reflog.
cleanupSessionRunning: A session may still be running; removing the worktree may fail because files are in use.
deleteUseArchive: Only want to hide it from the list? Use Archive instead.
acceptanceHintRepoDirtyMerge: The main repo has {n} uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them before merging.
syncConfirmHint: This message will be sent to the current session on your behalf:
longPathsHint: Run `git config --global core.longpaths true`; otherwise worktrees with deep paths may fail.
attentionEmptyHint: No tasks match the current filter.
currentTaskFilteredOut: The open task no longer matches the filter
attentionSummaryRecovery: {n} task(s) have not switched back; resolve the recovery first.
attentionStale: Status may be out of date · last updated at {time}
selectProjectHint: Choose the project to publish the task to.
selectProjectNoProjectHint: No projects yet. Add a Git repository project first.
draftConfirmHint: Keep the draft (for this workbench session only) or discard the changes.
publishResultUnknown: Publish result unknown: the request timed out — the task may have been created.
publishResultNotFound: Task still not found. Refresh again later; do not resubmit.
archiveMergedOnly: Only merged or cleaned tasks can be archived
publishTimeoutHint: The task may already exist. Refresh to confirm; do not submit again.
boardAddProjectFirst: No projects yet. Use ⊞ in the rail or the button below to add a Git repository.
boardCleanupConfirm: This removes the task's worktree directory; you can also delete the branch. Uncommitted changes require the Force option.
boardCriterionPlaceholder: Type an acceptance criterion, press Enter
boardDescriptionPlaceholder: Add context, constraints, or the expected outcome…
boardDiffTruncated: The diff is large; only part of it is shown.
boardMergeConfirm: Merge {branch} into {base}, then return to the original branch.
boardNoDiffHint: This task has no diff against its base right now.
boardNoSessionHint: Start a session and live USER / TOOL / AGENT records will appear here.
boardPreviewBaseAhead: The base branch has moved ahead; sync the baseline before merging.
boardPreviewBlocked: Blocked — merging is not possible right now.
boardPreviewConflict: Conflicts with the base branch; resolve them first.
boardPreviewOverlap: Touches the same files as the base; watch for conflicts.
searchSyntaxHint: Try tag:frontend priority:high status:review; quote values with spaces, e.g. tag:"needs design".
boardSelectTaskHint: Pick a task on the left, or publish a new worktree task.
boardStartAfterPublish: Start an agent session after publishing
boardStartAfterPublishHint: Bind the worktree and send the first prompt automatically.
boardSwitchDirty: The worktree has {n} uncommitted changes; they will be stashed before switching.
boardCheckoutDetached: Note: the main repository will be on a detached HEAD (not on any branch) while you review; use "Return to original branch" to restore it.
boardNoCommitYet: No commit yet (the agent may still be writing)
boardTitlePlaceholder: e.g. Fix the redirect after the login session expires
boardDiffMergedHint: Merged: these are the changes the merge commit introduced.
boardPreviewMerged: Branch is merged; the worktree can be cleaned up.
boardPreviewCleaned: Worktree cleaned; the branch is unmerged and kept.
boardPreviewCleanedMerged: Worktree cleaned; the branch is merged.
boardStashDropConfirm: These changes cannot be restored from the board afterwards. Drop this stash?
restoreFailed: Could not switch back to the original branch after merging

boardDeleteConfirmCleaned: This task's worktree is already cleaned; deleting the record only removes the board entry and keeps the repository and commits untouched.

boardCarryLeftover: Carry the {n} commits added after the merge

reportTruncated: The diff is large; the file list was truncated and the totals cover only the files kept.

mergeGateBlocked: {n} acceptance criteria are still unchecked and this project enables the merge gate
templateHint: Pick a template when publishing to fill the title, description and acceptance criteria; only criteria in the library are picked, the rest become manual criteria.
templateEmpty: No templates yet. Create one below and it will appear in the publish dialog.
templateDeleteConfirm: This cannot be undone. Delete this template?
quickPromptPlaceholder: Send an instruction to this session…
